errors.what: Panel wheel angle disagrees with the drawn wheel pose during engagement. At phi=30 the pin sits at about 137.6 deg from the wheel centre, so the slot (and wheel) should be rotated about -42.4 deg (panel about 317.6), but the panel shows 327.9 (-32.1). Likewise at phi=330 the drawn slot is near 312-315 deg while the panel shows 302.1. The panel follows a different law from the rendered motion. Direction, dwell and the 315 deg dwell value look correct.
